description: Compliance gap analysis. Compares a stack manifest (the services, cookies and personal data a product uses) with a saved policy and returns missing disclosures, overstated claims, missing policy types and recommendations. Without a policy_id, it reports which policies the stack needs and what they must cover. Does not use generation quota.

manifest.description: Summary of the services, cookies and personal data the product uses, e.g. {"analytics":["posthog"],"payments":["stripe"],"ai_features":["openai"],"cookies":["session","_ph_*"],"jurisdiction_signals":["EU locales"],"user_data_collected":["email","usage_events"]}.

policy_id.description: Policy (UUID) to audit the manifest against. Omit to audit the manifest alone.

name: audit_compliance
title: Audit compliance
